nodes.author: vipintukur
nodes.text: Instead of containing whole, inactivated RSV, like the vaccine linked to the tragedy, the new vaccines consist of RNA encoding a single RSV surface protein, known as F, that helps the virus fuse to human cells. (The hMPV component codes for the F protein in that virus.) 8/ https://t.co/IKr99cKCYE

nodes.author: vipintukur
nodes.text: The F protein exists in either a pre- or post-fusion form. Experts showed that vaccines using the protein locked into a prefusion form would, by revealing occluded portions in the postfusion state, teach the immune system to make highly potent “neutralizing” antibodies. 9/ https://t.co/RAXZpXdn9M

nodes.author: DonEford
vipintukur
nodes.text: This strategy works in adults. But the new data suggest it may not protect infants from the inappropriate immune response, which leads to so-called “vaccine-associated enhanced respiratory disease”. 10/ https://t.co/9QmTL1TUe2

nodes.author: vipintukur
nodes.text: Based on the Moderna findings, FDA has suspended enrollment in 11 RSV vaccine trials that present F or other RSV proteins to the immune system, either directly, or via mRNA or harmless viruses engineered to make the molecules.  11/

nodes.author: vipintukur
nodes.text: But FDA did not put any ban on 15 other trials, testing various live, weakened forms of RSV. Those “attenuated” vaccines most closely mimic the 1st natural infection in children, which does not increase their risk of developing severe disease from subsequent infection. 12/

nodes.author: vipintukur
nodes.text:
Scientists aren’t certain Moderna’s data signal a real problem, but the company has already stopped studies and abandoned development of the vaccines.  13/13

https://t.co/lCAEjrxkrO https://t.co/gyJNZTmKbb
